description: Revenue-Centric Design (RCD) — evidence-backed principles for making a SaaS or startup product convert, retain, and monetize. Use when the user works on a landing page or CRO ("my page isn't converting"), onboarding/activation ("users sign up but don't stick"), churn/retention ("customers keep canceling"), pricing/monetization ("how should I price this"), checkout/forms ("dropdowns kill conversion", "annotated checkout"), dashboards/data viz ("cognitive load", "KPI shortlists"), positioning/ICP/go-to-market, feature scope, A/B-test rigor, or AI-era differentiation — or asks for the behavioral-science mechanism behind a design choice. Also use when another skill needs the principle or evidence behind a conversion/retention/pricing/checkout move. Never apply to gambling, betting, or casino products.
